authorization: Researcher prioritizes decoding phase transitions and correction thresholds in the continuing Lab 008 study.
question: Can open boundary-fan multiplicity for the shortest selector be given a size-uniform summable physical tail, or does a nested square fan defeat such a bound?
claim_boundary: The predecessor identifies a two-environment boundary-fan gap from exact L3/L4 controls. This contract tests only the missing tail mechanism and cannot infer a threshold from finite multiplicities.
alternatives: Inject r alternate selected paths into boundary endpoint, first-divergence and reconnection witnesses, retaining the two distinct preimage environments.
Derive a disjoint-arm or pivotal-event domination and audit whether BK/Reimer-type product-measure hypotheses survive majority-domain and selector conditioning.
Construct nested square fan/comb templates and compare multiplicity growth with the exact number of edge constraints needed for physical realization.
planned_steps: State the exact tail identity kappa_L=sum_r Pr(M>=r) and the minimal witness multiplicity/probability inequalities needed for summability.
Test the witness injection and event-domination premises on the existing L3/L4 controls; do not enumerate L5.
Analyze bounded symbolic fan/comb templates with at most 20 explicit edges and stop at a proved tail reduction, a compatible obstruction, or a named conditioning gap.
acceptance_criteria: Every proposed tail witness distinguishes its physical state, selected target and alternate preimage environment.
Any probability inequality states whether it is unconditional product measure, majority-domain conditional, or full-charge conditional.
Any fan obstruction reports both multiplicity growth and physical event probability rather than multiplicity alone.
No L5 enumeration, finite-size trend fit, midpoint classification or threshold claim is made.
stop_rule: Stop after the bounded boundary-fan tail matrix. Do not enlarge the lattice enumeration, fit kappa_L, or treat finite fan mass as an asymptotic lower bound.

observed_findings.tail_replay: the size-biased tail sum exactly equals kappa at L3 and L4
observed_findings.finite_injection: alternate rough endpoints plus first virtual divergence/reconnection uniquely encode all 28 L3 and 129688 L4 ordered alternate preimages
observed_findings.probability_interface: BK/Reimer applies to disjoint reasons in one product-measure configuration; the selector collision uses two configurations and a majority-domain size-biased law
observed_findings.bounded_template: one through four isolated diamond-chain templates have 2^n paths and maximum selector multiplicity 2^(n-1), but omit outside square paths and the physical majority filter
observed_findings.claim_boundary: no uniform conditional fan tail, physical nested obstruction, midpoint classification or threshold is established

decision: Close the direct BK/Reimer shortcut. Retain a conditioned two-environment fan tail, or a full-strip transfer obstruction with its physical probability, as the unresolved target.
